violation_type.title: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms (26 TAC §746.3001(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed with children on a buggy ride around the street circle off the operation's property and was not carrying the required medical consent forms or emergency contact information for each child present on the ride.    This was corrected during inspection by the director stating that buggy rides off property will no longer be conducted.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver was observed with children on a buggy ride around the street circle off the operation's property and was not carrying the required medical consent forms or emergency contact information for each child present on the ride.    This was corrected during inspection by the director stating that buggy rides off property will no longer be conducted.

One child did not have emergency contact information in the binder while on a field trip.    This was corrected at inspection when the director made copy of the emergency contact information portion of the child's admission forms and placed it in the transportation binder.

The operational staff did not carry the list of emergency medical consent forms and emergency contact information for each child that attend the field trips for date of March 3, March 4, March 5 and March 6.
Emergency medical authorization for each child transported on a field trip was not available. Emergency and parent contact information was not listed for 2 children.

During a field trip to the park and the movies, the staff that were present did not have the emergency medical consent forms and emergency contact information for each child on the field trip as required.
The emergency bag that the operation takes on walking field trips was missing emergency authorization consent forms.
